parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Levels
parameters.description:
The severity of the malicious image sample that you want to query. You can enter multiple severities. Separate the severities with commas (,). Valid values:

*   **serious**
*   **suspicious**
*   **remind**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-matched-malicious-names --levels serious --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeMatchedMaliciousNames --region cn-hangzhou --Levels serious --Lang zh
